FN-G391G26-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 1
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Barbara Boyd
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 1 as introduced could increase receipts to the various funds that receive a
distribution from the exisiting $200 court fee by requiring the installation of an approved
ignition interlock device upon the first conviction of driving under the influence. The required
$200 fee for each ignition interlock device is distributed as follows:
 17% to the Alabama Interlock Indigent Fund ($34)
 30% to either the State Judicial Administration Fund for cases in state circuit or district
court ($60)
 30% to the municipal judicial administration fund for cases in municipal court ($60) or
 30% to the Highway Traffic Safety Fund ($60)
 23% to the District Attorney's Solicitor Fund ($46)
